mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing amitriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic/CNS effects; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor for increased amitriptyline adverse effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms, orthostasis); consider amitriptyline dose reduction if toxicity develops; baseline and periodic EKG monitoring recommended given amitriptyline's cardiac effects.
